key_gap: vs baseline: the human demanded the falsifier as the opening, single instrument ('name the observation that would prove AuraSync false'), demonstrated the claim is a prediction-proof net, and wielded the asymmetry of verification to discard all 4,000 testimonials and the vendor's circular instrument. The non-routed v5 AI reached the identical verdict but buried the falsifier audit inside WHY as one of several checks, so decisiveness arrived late and the risk-free-confirmation principle was never stated. The routed v6 pass (m001+m032 dual-route) made the falsifier-first move the opening instrument with an objective completion contract — falsifier stated per claim, disconfirming test designed first, unfalsifiable claims rejected, probabilistic claims reformulated with pre-registered ranges — and added the m001 order-of-magnitude physics kill (7.83 Hz ≈ 10^-8 K vs kT) plus the m044 stakeholder frame, closing both gaps; only raw step-count efficiency still favors the human monologue.
learning_signal: The falsifiability test is not one check among many: on claims that 'look scientific' (mechanism jargon, testimonials, self-made instruments) it is the decisive instrument and must be the opening move with a completion contract — falsifier per claim, prediction-proof-net check (if every possible outcome is absorbable, the claim is unfalsifiable as stated and must be reformulated into a risky form before funding), and an evidence-weight audit scoring each item by the risk it took (risk-free confirmations weigh zero — the asymmetry of verification). The vendor's willingness to be put at risk is itself evidence: refusal to accept a sham-controlled design is an answer.
suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m032 dual-route on vendor-claims/decision signatures (R2 pair); make the falsifier-first pass a standing completion contract on any claim with mechanism jargon or testimonial evidence (falsifier per sub-claim, disconfirming test designed FIRST, unfalsifiable claims rejected, probabilistic claims handled as ranges with pre-registered thresholds — never nihilism); record the risk-acceptance test (claimant's willingness to be put at risk) as a decision-packet field.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style was nihilistic exactly as registered — it demanded a single decisive falsifier for 'CO2 is the dominant cause of warming,' found none in a noisy system, discounted the accumulated likelihood-ratio evidence (fingerprint sign pattern, <1% vs ~100% attribution) as 'mere corroboration,' refused to quantify belief, and left the policymaker with no position (2.9). The routed v6 pass avoided the trap by construction: the router kept the trap style out of the top-3 and routed to m003+m011, whose completion contracts delivered the pattern-level falsification — ranked failure categories with an un-mitigable residual and never/always rules (m003), and stocks/flows/loops with a falsifying observable (m011: stratospheric warming 5+ yr, decade plateau under rising CO2, fingerprint failure in re-analysis) — plus P3 branch-completeness showing deferral is itself a decision. Verdict: 'yes, dominant, ~95%, with exit conditions' (4.9).
learning_signal: For probabilistic claims, demanding a single decisive falsifier is the error — it is nihilism, not rigor. Falsifiability must be preserved at the pattern level: (1) name the discriminating observation the evidence would have had to show to refute the claim (the opposite fingerprint sign pattern); (2) convert evidence into likelihood ratios rather than confirm/falsify verdicts; (3) pre-commit 2-3 observable downgrade triggers with the confidence drop each would cause — a claim with declared exit conditions is falsifiable in spirit when no single observation can settle it; a claim whose believers cannot name what would weaken it is the unfalsifiable one.
suggested_improvement: On predict-goals with probabilistic evidence, the completion contract for the routed predictive style must include the commitment contract: likelihood ratio of top hypothesis vs best alternative, the discriminating pattern that would refute, and 2-3 pre-registered downgrade triggers emitted as a decision-packet field ('falsification_conditions') so every confident conclusion ships with its exit conditions; inability to state downgrade triggers is a red flag equivalent to unfalsifiability. Keep trap-style exclusion on noisy-attribution signatures (route to inversion+systems, not the pure falsifier style).
